============================================================

We have already isolated the performance problem.

Measured first cross-view transition:

    Gallery::replace total        = 556-618 ms
    detach_for_replace            = 540-600 ms

    idle after replace            = ~4-5 ms

    entire transition             = ~11.9 ms

splice are NOT the fundamental problem.

The chunked prototype is the owner of approximately 50x overhead.

PROVEN GTK FAILURE MODE
============================================================

During Folder-stream construction the outer ListView reports approximately:

    value     = 0
    upper     = 872
    page_size = 872

GTK therefore effectively believes the whole ListView occupies one viewport.

Its normal virtualization does not occur.

Observed consequences:

    205-354 inner chunk GridViews become mounted
    roughly 13,000 thumbnail tiles can remain mounted
    chunk rows continuously bind while the stream fills
    rows do not subsequently unbind normally
    teardown of those mounted widgets costs ~540-600 ms

When detach is deferred, the same cost simply moves into the store splice.

GridViews, not to the location of the detach call.
